platform_tested: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold6 / Android 16 / arm64
portability.rule: Each phone must earn its own Veritas receipt.

ordinary.purpose: development, files, Git, Node, network, Remote MCP

privileged.purpose: permitted Android package/settings/activity/service diagnostics and actions

native.purpose: UI, accessibility, camera, microphone, Bluetooth, USB/HID, notifications and other app/native surfaces

recommended_on: adb_wifi_enabled when wireless lane is in use
recommended_off: don't keep activities / always finish activities
developer_options.background_process_limit: standard/default unless a qualified experiment says otherwise

known_failures.repair: turn Debug GPU overdraw off; do not change unrelated developer options
complete Wireless Debugging/Shizuku pairing before Start
fresh export + package ID + read-only DEX; if still unhealthy use direct authenticated ADB

known_failures.signature: ordinary app UID cannot see expected package
known_failures.repair: corroborate with UI or privileged package query; Android package visibility may hide it

known_failures.signature: shell package query hits secondary profile denial
known_failures.symptom: Package Manager prints SecurityException for another user/profile
known_failures.repair: scope query to the active Android user

safety.mutation_rule: Explicit Creator/user authorization + rollback + acceptance test required.
